notes.title: 💫 SEXSTELLAR is here! 💫
notes.content:
[h3]The wait is over, Commander. Dive into the ultimate erotic sci-fi thriller that will awaken your deepest fantasies.

You're stranded on a space station with the mesmerizing Cassiopeia — every glance, every touch, pulling you closer. But behind her sultry eyes lies a mystery: one of you isn’t human.
Can you trust her? Or yourself? Or… does it even matter when desire takes control?

[b]Key Features:[/b]
✨ Intense adult interactions — caresses, kisses, and more as you unlock her trust.
✨ A steamy sci-fi setting — feel the heat as the cold stars watch your every move.
✨ Choices matter — build a bond, or break it. Your decisions lead to different endings.
✨ Sexy mini-games — quick, hot challenges to keep your pulse racing.

[b]🚀 FREE KEY GIVEAWAY! 🚀[/b]
